golden.world: pkg/test_flaky.py: STATE = []; test_a_first asserts STATE == [1]; test_b_pollutes appends 2
golden.evidence: seed 0 passed; seeds 1-3 failed -- the outcome changed while the bytes did not

classification_law: flaky_tests: outcome CHANGED across runs (evidence, with the seeds that produced it)
consistently_failing: failed in EVERY run -- a broken test, kept separate so it is never 'fixed' by rerunning
stable: passed in every run, and detection_scope states that this is a statement about the run budget, not a certificate of determinism
honesty_legs_observed: repeats < 2 refuses REPEATS_BELOW_TWO: one execution is a test run, not a flake hunt
a suite with no tests refuses NO_TESTS_FOUND instead of reporting zero flakes
a collection error refuses TESTS_COULD_NOT_RUN instead of reporting zero flakes
the measured tree is byte-untouched: the order-shuffling plugin is written to a temp dir and put on PYTHONPATH for the child run only
same tree, same budget -> the same flaky set (pinned)

reuse_note: the pytest invocation shape (python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider, cwd = the project root, refusal taxonomy TOOL_NOT_INSTALLED / TESTS_COULD_NOT_RUN / NO_TESTS_FOUND) is python.quality.coverage.v1's; the artifact/expect/gate shape is the refactor family's
